note: How a unit is made to travel, in place of what a receiving end would otherwise choose for it.

fields.name: speed
fields.note: How fast the unit travels along the path, in world units a second, standing in for its own pace.

fields.name: gravity
fields.note: How sharply the unit arcs through the air along the way. Zero where it keeps to the ground, and zero in 185 of the 290 observed.

fields.name: fromX
fields.note: Where the unit starts, along one ground axis, in world units. It holds the same place the path's first point states, and is carried whether the unit arcs or not.

fields.name: fromZ
fields.note: Where it starts, along the other.

fields.name: keepFacing
fields.note: Whether the unit holds the way it already faces rather than turning to face where it is going.

fields.name: follows
fields.note: The unit this one is made to follow, or zero where it follows none.

fields.name: followDistance
fields.note: How far from that unit it is made to stay, in world units. Zero in everything observed.

fields.name: followBackDistance
fields.note: How far behind that unit it is made to stay, in world units. Zero in everything observed.

fields.name: followTime
fields.note: How long the following runs. It is zero wherever no unit is followed, and 20000 in every one that follows a unit. What the figure counts is not recorded here.
